gaps: There is no catalog assertion that independently verifies no backend order or event was created after dismissing the dialog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: There is no catalog assertion that independently verifies no backend order or event was created after dismissing the dialog.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary as the buyer.
Open the Recreate Order action from the stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up is open.

args.goal: click the × close control at the top right of the Recreate Order pop-up and stop with the pop-up closed on the existing project page

steps.note: Perform the case-specific dismissal using the pop-up's cross control.
Verify that dismissing the pop-up leaves the buyer on the existing project summary rather than navigating to a newly created order.
